name: DM pairing
summary: On a messaging channel, a sender the agent doesn't know gets a short pairing code and their messages are ignored until the owner approves the code. OpenClaw uses it as the default way to decide who may talk to the agent in direct messages.
how: Bot replies with a one-time code and drops the message
Owner approves the code from the CLI or control UI
Approved sender is added to that channel's allowlist
facts: Grants DM access only, not group access
goodFor: Personal agents on WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and similar
Stopping strangers from prompting your agent
watchOut: Only controls who can talk to the agent, not what it does
An approved contact can still send prompt injections
